reference_policy: Written public brief only; no private example.
focus: New-task extension of legacy-detail-20261019-v2. Numeric compliance requires native measurements; never infer dimensions from perspective images.

anchors.0: Absent, wholly wrong, or no visible evidence of the required result; no credit.
anchors.1: Weak resemblance/fulfilment (about one quarter); major omissions or pervasive defects.
anchors.2: Partial (about half); recognizable intent but material errors in key requirements or visual quality.
anchors.3: Mostly correct (about three quarters); concrete remaining discrepancies prevent excellent credit.
anchors.4: Excellent: all important visible requirements satisfied, coherent and polished, no material discrepancy. Requires explicit positive evidence, not merely lack of reported faults.

checks.question: 净空测量是否排除被评估机器人、计入其他设施和突出物，并提供路线采样坐标与测量约定？
units: Navigation clearance refers to the free route excluding the robot being evaluated; include all other furnishings and protrusions. Provide route sample coordinates and the measurement conventions in README.

checks.question: 第二视角是否揭示关键接触和净空路线，并与主视角保持相同几何及冻结姿态？
units: Render alternate.png from a second perspective camera chosen to expose the critical contacts and clearance routes; follow any suggested alternate view when useful. Both views must show the same geometry and frozen pose

checks.question: 几何是否采用米制和 Z 向上；若使用可达球，是否仅作为几何包络而非运动学或动力学认证？
units: Use metres and Z up. Build editable, solid three-dimensional geometry with separable semantic components, meaningful thickness and plausible support. A static articulated robot pose is required; no controller, physical dynamics or manipulation trajectory is required. Represent specified joints and end-effectors geometrically. Reach spheres are geometric envelope checks, not certification of inverse-kinematic or dynamic feasibility.
